{{Vanilla|Monster Room}}
A '''dungeon''' (monster room) is a small underground room with a spawner and chests. [[Matcha Flavoured]] makes dungeons more common, changes their spawners and changes their chest loot.

== Generation ==
Dungeons are placed by two features:<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/worldgen/placed_feature/monster_room.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/worldgen/placed_feature/monster_room_deep.json}}</ref>
{| class="wikitable"
! Feature !! Attempts per chunk !! Vanilla !! Height range
|-
| <code>monster_room</code> || 15 || 10 || Y=0 to the top of the world
|-
| <code>monster_room_deep</code> || 8 || 4 || 6 blocks above the bottom of the world to Y=-1
|}

== Structure ==
After the vanilla room is generated, the pack places a spawner template at its center, replacing the vanilla spawner.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/worldgen/configured_feature/monster_room.json}}</ref> The spawner is a zombie, skeleton or spider spawner with equal chances (vanilla: zombies twice as likely). Its mobs carry the <code>NoDrops</code> tag and drop nothing. See [[Spawner]] for how spawners can be broken for [[Divine Fragment]]s.
